asatruarfelagid.name_en: The Ásatrú Fellowship (recorded by Statistics Iceland as "Pagan Worship")

pagan_chieftainship.name: Ásatrúarfélagið Rekyavíkur / Pagan Chieftainship of Reykjavík

nordicOrgs.recognized_note: Officially recognized as a religious organization by the Icelandic government in 1973, the first modern Heathen organization in the world to receive state recognition.
nordicOrgs.note: Broke ground on Hörgr, a real temple in Öskjuhlíð, Reykjavík, on March 20, 2015, timed to a solar eclipse.

nordicOrgs.recognized_note: A separate, smaller state-registered Heathen organization, tracked independently by Statistics Iceland since 2007.
nordicOrgs.note: Real but far smaller than Ásatrúarfélagið; membership has stayed in the 18-39 range since first being registered.

nordicOrgs.recognized_note: Recognized as a religious community (trossamfund) by the Danish state in 2003.
nordicOrgs.note: Denmark does not publish a public annual membership time series the way Iceland does.

nordicOrgs.recognized_note: Founded in 1994 as Sveriges Asatrosamfund; renamed Samfundet Forn Sed Sverige in 2010.
nordicOrgs.note: Sweden does not publish a public annual membership time series the way Iceland does.

nordicOrgs.recognized_note: Founded in 1998. A specific state-recognition date could not be independently verified, so none is claimed here.
nordicOrgs.note: Norway does not publish a public annual membership time series the way Iceland does.
